sourceProof.sourceDirtyInterpretation: Generic sourceDirty=true includes documentation and untracked evidence; all measured app/native/package/pin/runner paths clean at reviewed HEAD.
sourceProof.engineN/A: No engine changes for this campaign; actual reviewed runtime a6 and separate reviewed measurement tool63 consumed unchanged.

method.latency: Actual consumer ViewModel/repository command through deliberate final repaint to matched fresh native frame rasterFinish in shared VM monotonic clock. Timing callback delivery excluded from elapsed.
method.initialReadiness: Public root/warm-up/first-raster readiness occurs before fresh frame baseline under the same total10s guard; readiness cannot substitute for actual fresh native ID/rasterFinish. Bootstrap outside operation latency; changed setup remains in broader aggregate resources for later iterations.
method.independence: Each iteration creates/prepares a new synthetic owned store outside elapsed. One native process per operation/profile20sample case; native/OS caches uncontrolled.
method.resources: Sampled direct-process RSS peak and cumulative Mach CPU across host start/end markers, including inter-iteration reset, bootstrap, rendering setup, callback idle and teardown. Resource metrics are aggregate, not separately attributable to one latency sample. Descendants excluded. CPU100% means one logical core; >100% possible.
method.sampling: 20ms requested sample interval; sampled RSS is not guaranteed instantaneous peak.
method.statistics: Host median (p50),nearest-rank p95 and all20 raw samples retained without selection.
method.quietConditions: Exclusive runtime/profile slot; no concurrent Flutter tests, other profiles or heavy commands; task Android AVD off. Only lightweight evidence reads/coordination during runs.
limits: No mobile performance evidence. Android preservation failure and iOS platform pending remain separate unresolved gates.
Largest account fixture near20MiB; workspace remains about3.4KiB with1active+40held, not near workspace maximum.
No performance target, optimization, historic specific interleaving/rootcause or reliability certification.
Bootstrap setup changed; old62/df72/Step3/isolated epochs excluded and no cross-epoch resource comparison.
